dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: What do you need made? I do custom orders too!

dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: Sure. Take your time, have a look around. If something catches your eye, try it out and see if it suits you.

dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: Your weapon is your comrade-in-arms, so pick with care. It's not uncommon to find that while a weapon may be fine in itself, it just isn't the right fit for you.

dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: Trust me, like a good comrade, a good weapon will be your lifeline when you need it most.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need anything at the moment. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: Right? So take your time to look around... Oh, right! If you need something a little more special, we can custom-make weapons too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Hertta
dialogues.text: Hmm? Around here? The only thing you need to keep an eye out for is the Wild Hunt. And even when it's brightly lit, you have to watch out for monsters at all times.
